narrativePost.fullText:
# LinkedIn Authority Post — Email-to-CRM Automation Engine

Most companies lose 15–30% of their revenue not because of bad marketing, but because of silent workflow breakdowns.

We built **Email-to-CRM Automation Engine** to solve this exact problem:
Inbound message intelligence pipeline that parses unstructured business emails, extracts entities (budget, timeline, company, intent), creates CRM records, and synthesizes customized replies.

### The Sentinel Claim Audit Registry
* **Benchmark Scenario:** Evaluated against synthetic multi-factor telemetry.
* **Demonstrated Latency:** Sub-millisecond calculation in zero-dependency Node.js runtime.
* **Live In-Browser Sandbox:** https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/email-to-crm-automation/
* **Source Code:** https://github.com/bawagideon/email-to-crm-automation

#SoftwareEngineering #B2B #Automation #SystemsEngineering #GideonHQ
